standard_prerequisites.name: CM locus of flat lfp morphisms
Slicing
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the regular immersion Z -> V with Z = {v}.

standard_prerequisites.name: Unramified and lci permanence
standard_prerequisites.use: Certify the composed Z -> X_y is unramified lci.

core_obligations: Pick a nonempty affine etale V -> X_y and a CM closed point v, slice to a regular immersion Z = {v} -> V, and check Z -> Spec(k) is finite locally free of some degree d.
Certify Z -> X_y unramified and lci by composing the named permanence lemmas, and convert to an object of H_{d,lci}.
proof_roadmap: Construction chain: etale cover, CM point, slice, finiteness, then the unramified/lci certification by composition lemmas.
difficulty_reason: Single construction with a long but displayed certification chain.
